utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Dane, I’m still piecing together the repair drive updates second-hand—do you know who’s keeping the list or what gaps are still biggest?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m catching up too, Nell, but I think Hana is trying to keep the triage organized. I’d rather not guess—let’s get the current list from her before we decide what gaps are biggest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That makes sense, thanks Dane—I’ll check with Hana for the current list before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal, thanks for checking in—the repair drive is Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, and we’re taking small appliances, lamps, bikes, and torn clothing, but no hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara—I’ll mark the community room for Saturday 10 to 2 and note the accepted items plus the no-hazardous-items reminder on my location list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate you noting that. Let me know if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Morning, Noah — I’ve got the toolbox, cordless drill, socket set, screwdrivers, pliers, and extension cords ready, and I’ll swing by out front a little before 9 Saturday to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus—that’s a lifesaver. I’ll meet you out front before 9 Saturday, assuming I don’t wander off looking for the hall first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, I’ll head out front a little before 9 Saturday and keep an eye out for you. If you get turned around, just text me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Vik, I’ve got myself down for Saturday morning at the community room to sort and label the broken appliances—if there’s anything special you want on the labels, just remind me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — if you can, label each item with what it is and whether it looks repairable or not. That’ll help us sort everything quickly on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—item name and whether it looks repairable or not. I’ll add that to my note now so I don’t muddle it Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Kira, I’m still gathering repair requests and matching them with supply needs, but I’m hoping to have the first names and items ready for Rosa by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’ll have the first names and item list ready for Rosa by Friday, right? I want to be sure it’s actually locked in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, that’s locked in—I’ll have the first names and supply needs ready for Rosa by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll spread the word: Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, and folks can bring small appliances, lamps, bikes, and torn clothing. Just no hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll pass that along while I’m out and keep asking around for the exact repair list and helpers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a huge help. I’ll keep asking around for the exact repair list and any extra helpers.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Pia, bring any repair items to the hall tomorrow morning; we’ll sort after lunch and handle safety fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds workable, Leo, but who’s keeping track of each item and where should people leave drop-offs before lunch? I just want to make sure the handoff stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa’s keeping the item list, and people can leave drop-offs at the hall’s front table before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be great—if you hear what folks need most or which spot works best, I can help spread the word and line up a few hands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — send me the reported repairs and the best spot, and I’ll sort the urgent ones first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll gather the reported repairs and compare the best spots, then send you the list so you can sort the urgent ones first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey, I’m glad you’re checking in about the repair drive—I’ve got safety fixes at the top of the list, and Cleo is gathering names and supplies by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll bring my two extension cords and small toolkit, all labeled, and I’ll check in with Cleo before Friday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Rey — thank you for bringing those and keeping them labeled. Please do check in with Cleo before Friday, and I’ll match your tools to the first repair needs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I’m hearing good support for the repair drive—people seem ready to help out. I can ask around about space, clipboards, and who can handle drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be good, Tess. I’ll quietly pass along what Quinn told me too, as much as I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Uli—that could really help. I’ll keep asking around on my end and we can piece the logistics together quietly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Eli, do you know who’s keeping the repair drive list, and what still needs fixing right now?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m keeping the list, Mina; right now I have Gus down for tools at 9 on Saturday, and I’m still checking which lamps, chairs, and small appliances need repair.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Eli—can you send me the current list of broken items and anyone else signed up, so I don’t duplicate anything?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam, quick version—I’m in for one headcount and can do an after-school pickup window if you’ve got the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That helps a lot, Bo—thanks. I’ll send you the time and place for the pickup window.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—send it over and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Kira! I’m helping spread the word: the repair drive is Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room—bring small appliances, lamps, bikes, or torn clothing, but no hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Quinn—just to confirm, it’s definitely this Saturday from 10 to 2 in the community room, and no hazardous items, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, that’s right — this Saturday from 10 to 2 in the community room, and please no hazardous items. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, I’m trying to help Mina pin down the repair drive list—do you know what’s still broken and who’s already signed up to help?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I know we’re collecting broken small appliances for the repair drive, and Oren’s already on sorting and labeling duty. I don’t have the full signup list yet, but I can pass along the details once Mina confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — that helps. I’ll pass along the small-appliance list and Oren’s sorting duty to Mina, and keep checking for the rest of the signups.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Rey, I’ve got Gus down for a Saturday 9 o’clock drop-off with the drill, socket set, screwdrivers, pliers, and extension cords; let’s keep a clear sign-in sheet so everything gets returned.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good — I’ll label my cords and toolkit, and the sign-in sheet should help keep everything straight.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that keeps things orderly. I’ll bring the sign-in sheet and a pen, and we can set everything out right at 9.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Faye, I’m ready to help with the repair drive—can you send me the reported repairs and note any that seem urgent or already have volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll send over the reported repairs and flag any urgent ones or spots that already have volunteers. I’m just trying to keep it around school pickup times, so I appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — send them when you can, and I’ll sort the urgent repairs first while keeping the timing around school pickup in mind.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Bo, I’m still piecing together what’s needed for the repair drive—have you heard who’s keeping the list or what gaps are left?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think Faye’s keeping the practical list—headcount plus pickup/drop-off gaps around school hours. I told her I’m in for one and can do an after-school pickup window if she sends the time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps a lot—thanks, Bo. If you hear the biggest gaps from Faye, could you let me know so I can pass it along?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds great—once you check availability, I can ask around which spot feels easiest for folks to get to.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect—once you’ve checked availability, send it over and I’ll help narrow down the easiest spot for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll wait for Opal’s availability list, then I’ll send it your way so we can compare what’s easiest for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Pia—right, the repair drive is tomorrow at the hall, drop-off first and sorting after lunch. Gus is bringing tools and cords, and I’m trying not to forget my box of busted cords too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks—do we have someone assigned to log what comes in and keep the drop-offs organized? I just want to make sure nothing gets misplaced.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, I don’t think we’ve locked that down yet. If you can help keep track of the drop-offs, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still leaning toward the community room or the library annex, and I can check which one’s available. I’ll also make a quick pros-and-cons list so we can pick the easiest spot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—please check both and pick the one with easier drop-off access. We’re still meeting tomorrow, so let me know by tonight.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do—I’ll check both today, compare the drop-off access, and send you the better option by tonight so we’re ready for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I heard Quinn’s getting the word out about the repair drive; I can mention it quietly to a few folks I see today.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Uli—thanks. I’m helping Saturday and keeping the tool drop-off list organized, so if anyone offers tools, send me their name and location.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, Sam, I’ll keep it simple and pass along any tool offers with names and locations if I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can ask around today and see who can lend space, clipboards, or a hand with drop-offs. If we pin down the logistics early, the repair drive should run a lot smoother.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, Tess—please get names next to each offer, especially space, clipboards, and drop-off help, and tell me who’s keeping the main list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Mina—I’ll get names tied to each offer and check who’s holding the main list so we don’t end up with scraps of paper all over town.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Cleo—I'm helping Saturday morning at the community room, sorting and labeling the small appliances for the repair drive. If you see me looking puzzled, just remind me I wrote it down!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren—I’ll mark you down for Saturday morning appliance sorting at the community room. I’ll keep the labels and supply notes handy so we can stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks Cleo—labels and supply notes handy sounds exactly like what my scattered brain needs Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Count me in, Mara — I can bring my toolbox and a few spare extension cords for the repair drive. Just let me know where you want them dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that would be a big help. Please drop them off at the community room on Saturday, and if you can come a little before 10, we can get everything set up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Mara — I’ll bring the toolbox and extension cords to the community room a little before 10 on Saturday and help get set up.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
